usdm_decimals.meaning: number of decimals of the USDM underlying asset

decimals_offset.meaning: value returned by _decimalsOffset() used by sUSDM share conversion

expected_decimals.meaning: underlyingDecimals + _decimalsOffset(), the scaling that matches balanceOf() share accounting

assumptions: At least one external protocol integrates sUSDM using the standard ERC-20 decimals() pattern to interpret balances (assume_integration_uses_decimals).
The vault's balanceOf() values are raw 12-decimal shares as described by the internal accounting; only the decimals() getter scaling is formalized.

unresolved.description: The report infers that 12 is the intended decimals() value from OZ base behavior and the ONE_SUSDM = 1e12 constant rather than explicit documentation; expected_decimals is grounded as underlyingDecimals + _decimalsOffset() from the stated intent.

limitations: Only the direct decimals() mismatch impact (impact_decimals_6_instead_of_12) is formalized; the downstream 10^6 overestimate (impact_overestimate_1e6) and 1,000,000x borrow impact (impact_borrow_1e6x) are deferred to future claims.
No concrete deployed external integration or transaction is bound; all impact scenarios remain conditional/potential.
The precise collateral/lending formula using decimals() is not given beyond the illustrative 100e12 / 1e6 example, so only the getter correspondence is encoded.
Runtime binding of symbolic integers to concrete on-chain values is deferred.
